source.prompt: What CRM should a marketing agency use to manage client pipelines?
source.note: real collected answer; brand, competitors and publishers are the specs the cycle was scored with

answer.text:
For a marketing agency, the "best" CRM depends heavily on your agency's size, your pricing model (retainers vs. project-based), and whether you need a pure sales pipeline or an all-in-one marketing suite.
The top options for managing marketing agency client pipelines break down by use-case:
HubSpot: — Best overall for growth-focused and inbound agencies
Why it fits:: It offers an intuitive visual deal pipeline, brilliant email integration, robust contact management, and seamless scaling from a great free tier up to enterprise levels. It matches an agency's vibe because you can manage your own prospective clients and later use similar mechanics if you manage client portals or inbound tracks.
The catch:: Pricing can scale up steeply once you move past the starter tiers into advanced automations or custom reporting.
Pipedrive: — Best for pure, sales-heavy pipeline simplicity
Why it fits:: If your agency's primary bottleneck is closing outbound leads and tracking discovery calls, Pipedrive is ultra-visual, fast, lightweight, and laser-focused on moving deals cleanly through custom stages. It requires minimal training.
The catch:: It’s strictly a sales CRM, meaning you will need external tools for heavy marketing automation or project management.
GoHighLevel: — Best for agencies wanting bundled marketing funnels and white-labeling
Why it fits:: It is built explicitly with agencies in mind. It bundles a robust pipeline manager with landing pages, SMS/email marketing, and automation workflows at a flat monthly rate. You can even white-label it for your own clients.
The catch:: The interface can feel overwhelming or "all-in-one cluttered" compared to cleaner, dedicated CRMs.
ActiveCampaign: — Best for email- and automation-driven pipelines
Why it fits:: Excellent for agencies that run high-touch email nurture sequences before a prospect converts into a client. It allows you to segment pipelines cleanly by client type or location with powerful, lower-cost automation.
